title: No-Fuss Haloumi Pasta
subtitle: with Ratatouille Sauce
description: You may notice this recipe's back for a victory lap – that's because sometimes you can't beat a tried-and-true winner! Our Dinnerly home cooks loved this recipe, so here it is again for you to enjoy its easy cooking, big flavours and satisfying goodness.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Halve the zucchini lengthwise, then thickly slice. Cut the capsicum into 2cm chunks. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Thickly slice the haloumi.
Cook pasta: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 10 mins or until al dente. Reserve 60ml (¼ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta.

Start sauce: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the zucchini, capsicum, parsley stems, garlic and 2 tbs tomato paste, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until the vegetables are just tender.

Finish sauce: Add the tomatoes, 2 tsp red wine vinegar, ½ tsp sugar and the reserved cooking water to the capsicum mixture. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8 mins or until the sauce is slightly thickened. Stir in the pasta. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a small frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove from the pan, then cut or tear the slices in half. Divide the pasta among bowls, top with the fried haloumi, scatter over the parsley leaves and enjoy!
Make it spicy: For a spicy kick, scatter over chilli flakes to serve.
